description: APPROVAL CARD ONLY — NEVER auto-executed: propose 1–3 personalized trade opportunities (best-first) for in-app approval. Each idea is recorded as a proposed setup row (Diary → setups → Send to ticket) plus one batch trail row. Never executes, never moves funds. Needs the trade:propose scope (PAT).

ideas.description: 1–3 trade ideas, best-first. Each: pair (e.g. BTC/USDT), side buy|sell (long|short accepted as aliases), entry > 0, stop > 0 (long: stop<entry, short: stop>entry), targets 1–3x {price>0, weight (or fraction) 0..1}, thesis (required).

jev_verdict.description: Optional caller-supplied JEV verdict captured alongside the batch (run analyze_market first for a fresh one)
